description: One case per toggle: the estate with noInboundLifecycleRule on and nothing else. The known answer is F-LIFECYCLE-INBOUND, the Finding of Check LIFECYCLE-INBOUND, whose severity (Medium) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: noInboundLifecycleRule, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 noInboundLifecycleRule=true

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The inbound container has no lifecycle rule. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
